_provenance.warning: No cell of yours produced these and no datasheet is cited. Use them to get the model running. Replace with your own pulse-test measurements before any number from this model goes into a report.

NMC.note: workhorse EV and drone chemistry. steady slope, no hard plateau.

NCA.note: high energy density. sits slightly above NMC across the range.

LFP.note: very flat from 40 to 90 percent, only 0.25 V across half the range. Voltage tells you almost nothing about SOC here, so coulomb counting or a Kalman filter is mandatory.

LMO.note: WARNING: identical to NMC upstream, a copy-paste artifact in GAIA. Treat as a placeholder, not as an LMO curve.

LTO.note: low voltage, long life, high power. Needs about 1.5x the cells in series for the same pack voltage.
